resources.string: Still uses this during a focus session to see which app is on screen, send the apps you chose to block back to the home screen, and read the address bar of supported browsers to step back from websites you chose to block. It stores nothing about what you do and does nothing when no session is running. During a strict session it also covers the Settings pages that could switch Still off.
To block apps and websites, Still needs its accessibility service. It only checks what is open, and only while a session runs.
If Android says the setting is restricted, open App info, tap ⋮ and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Settings and uninstall screens that mention Still Focus are closed until the session ends, so Still can\'t be switched off early.
Blocked in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Firefox, Samsung Internet and DuckDuckGo, including links opened from other apps. Other browsers are blocked completely during sessions with websites.
Select between 1 and 100 apps or websites.
Choose a release delay from 1 to 120 minutes.
Still couldn\'t save the session. Free some storage and try again.

Give websites a daily allowance, or rest them at bedtime. Time counts while a site is the page you\'re using in a supported browser with the screen on, and resets at midnight. Limits work outside focus sessions and can be changed at any time.
